_readme: Queue written by the daily-reel-render task, drained by tools/apply_additions.py during tools/sync.bat. The task must NOT edit calendar.md or review-state.json directly - it queues here instead, and sync.bat folds these in AFTER pulling, on top of whatever the desk decided today. That is what stops the two files conflicting. Adds only: an existing calendar row (keyed on date + post title) is left exactly as the desk left it, and so is an existing review-state key - with one exception, the render flip (content: awaiting-render or rerender -> in-review, plus new revisions entries), which is what tells the desk a cut now exists. It can never write an approval; see the module docstring in tools/apply_additions.py.

revisions.changed: Rebuilt to fix the kicker spacing Min-Yi rejected on 09-11 (#1WHOTOUCHESITIN). tracked() joined letters with a plain space, so a word boundary became a collapsible run of whitespace and rendered identically to a letter boundary; the #1 prefix had the same fault. Joined with U+00A0, which needs no cooperation from either SVG reader. Copy is untouched and the script stays at rev 1. Kickers confirmed correct in the frames. Nothing else moved: 9 scenes, 0 problems, 885 frames at 29.50s, check_dull 0.23s against 0.45s. Cut v1 archived as reel38-the-check.v1.mp4.

scriptRevisions.changed: Scene 2's headline loses two words so the body fits. fit_body() refused the approved body and stopped the build: the three-line headline left 200px for a 364-character paragraph, short even at the 29px floor. The quotation, the body copy and every citation are unchanged. Layout is measured now, not estimated.
